scope: Declared before Newton replay: Nominal right little MCP rises from 1.55 to -0.09 rad over 4 s, then stays at its target during 1.2 s of feedback settling. Runtime right-thumb joint feedback uses current and one-frame predicted positions of the tracked far-material neighborhood. Thumb speed is bounded by 1 rad/s and every actual per-frame quintic by 3 rad/s. Nominal geometry is prechecked; all feedback proposals also pass runtime geometry and unchanged physical/material guards. The actual terminal joint pose is then frozen for a 1.2 s hold. No rope state, mass or rest length is edited. Helper contact is observed, never constrained. Hold 1.2 s.
